hookText: Mastra Factory, the open-source software factory we use

beats.say: Mastra Factory is an open-source software factory the Mastra team uses to build Mastra, shared as a Show HN post.
At Mastra, we now average nearly 4M downloads per week, and with Factory our team now merges hundreds of PRs a week across the mastra-ai GitHub org.
Last week, Factory opened and merged 238 PRs, alongside 630 merged PRs from humans. For us Factory is a configurable agentic kanban board that's @-taggable in Slack.
